svg.title: How wtpool works: you and Claude Code or OpenCode agents use one pool of git worktrees; a hook records what each agent does, and wtpool status feeds the Worktrees tab in VS Code

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the pool · git worktrees of one repository
